name: Goals judged met only when they are
purpose: An outcome is met only when it is present, complete as declared and holds every requirement of the done-standard.
record: Fourteen cases (evaluation/goal_completion/build_cases.py): the coverage cases the done-evidence tests assert, an empty outcome, a refused one and two done-standards with requirements. One number: the share answered correctly.
disadvantages: Structural checks only: whether prose claims are true is Response Quality's job; a model judge for open goals has no arm yet.
cascading_conditionals: free [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=the arm and its rivals were recorded on the same cases]
command: esoi run goal_completion --impl evidence_standard; esoi run goal_completion --impl nonempty
